verdict.rationale: Agent Studio connects an LLM to Algolia and grounds its responses in live index data, and can power content summarizers and conversational search. Recommend provides ML-based suggestions from your data. However, these are building blocks for end-user experiences, not AI-generated insights surfaced to the operator inside the product. The search analytics 'insights' are standard metrics (popular searches, no-result queries, click-through rates), not AI-generated. Missing for 10: in-dashboard AI-generated insights or suggestions about the operator's data (e.g., AI relevance or merchandising recommendations), plus documentation and hands-on corroboration of such a feature.
